Field guide.

Switch lanes. Jump fallen cactus and gaps. Duck under stone arches. Keep your three hearts beating.

ON A KEYBOARD← → or A D to steer
Space / ↑ / W to jump
↓ / S to duck · P to pause
ON YOUR PHONESwipe to steer, jump, or duck.
Or use the big buttons below.
Tap pause for a breather.
🥕

Carrot → Coyote Rush5 seconds of speed and protection. Charge through obstacles and gallop over gaps.

🍎

Apple → a little loveRecover one heart. Full health? Get a shield that absorbs your next hit.

⋒

Horseshoes → big scoresCollect a chain to grow your multiplier. Jump for the high ones.

🐝

Some things aren’t snacksDodge boulders and bees. Mud slows you down. Fallen cactus and gaps need a jump; stone arches need a duck.

A little late on a jump? You get a moment of grace at a ledge. You can also press jump just before landing.
